basic_info.description: At the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this bright and spacious home welcomes you. Enter the gracious foyer, then one step down brings you into the large living room flooded with light from the skylight atrium above. The adjacent formal dining room with built-in hutch and family room with a brass fire pole from the bedroom above have French doors leading to the sunny deck and flat yard. Equipped with professional grade stainless steel appliances, the gourmet kitchen has dual sinks, ample counter space and storage and a bright breakfast area. A half bath is conveniently located off the foyer as is a bonus room and full bath. The upper floor boasts four spacious bedrooms three full baths, laundry and a sheltered deck. The spacious primary suite has an en-suite bath with walk-in shower soaking tub and double sinks. The second spacious bedroom with ample closet space has direct access to the deck. Two full baths are located off the hall leading to the two comfortable bedrooms over looking the garden. Just minutes to Whole Foods, and the shops and restaurants of Eureka Valley, Mission Dolores, and the Valencia corridor, the location is rated a paradise for all forms of transportation. A convenient city home in a tranquil location. Do not be deceived by the understated exterior.
